limitations: The correction concerns the auxiliary Riccati-to-linear reduction in Wu--Hong Remark 4.21, not their main rank-two irreducibility theorem. The degree-parity condition is sufficient rather than necessary. General Riccati linearization and valuation methods are classical; originality is claimed only for the source-specific correction and its representation-theoretic corollary, to the best of our knowledge. No independent validation is asserted.
record_title: Corrected Riccati linearization and a degree-parity irreducibility criterion
